senses.gloss: m. (pl. of חֳפִי; חָפָה) covering over burnt clay vessels.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:14">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:14">ib.</cite>

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5:2">Par. V</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 4:2">IV</cite>), 2 (<he>לח׳</he>) <he>גילה ח׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. corrupt) if he removes the covering and finds dust on the vessels (proving that none had touched them; v. R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 5:1">Par. V, 1</cite> for correct version).
